description: Find people or companies you don't know yet, by filters. Not for someone you can already name: for a named person (with their company or domain, a LinkedIn URL or an email) or a named company, call people_company_enrich instead, including to find their email or phone. Every call needs entity and at least one provider block with filters; a call without them fails. Set entity to "person" or "company", then give each provider its filters for that entity: people by title, employer, location or seniority; companies by industry, headcount, location, technology or founding year. apollo: free for people, 30 credits per page for companies, once an organization admin has accepted its terms. fullenrich: 5 credits per record. people_data_labs: 50 credits per record, SQL or Elasticsearch query. firecrawl_search: web results, with the firecrawl_search tool's query parameters. Example: {"entity":"person","fullenrich":{"current_position_titles":[{"value":"Head of Data"}],"current_company_domains":[{"value":"example.com","exact_match":true}]},"apollo":{"person_titles":["Head of Data"],"q_organization_domains_list":["example.com"]}}. Each provider takes its own native parameters; nothing is shared between providers. Include a block only for each provider you want to run, e.g. "apollo": {...}; included providers run in parallel. The response lists every provider with its status, records, credits charged and any error.

anyOf.description: entity person: Apollo people/search. Free. No seniority, industry or headcount filter. Surnames come back masked: pass apollo_id as id to the apollo people/match capability through firecrawl_scrape to reveal.

per_page.description: Results per page, max 25. Use page for more.

person_titles.description: Job titles, e.g. ["Head of Data"]. Similar titles also match; adding titles can broaden results.

q_keywords.description: Free text matched across the person and their company.

anyOf.description: entity company: Apollo companies/search. 30 credits per page, empty pages included. No industry or founding-year filter.

currently_using_any_of_technology_uids.description: Apollo technology ids, lowercase with underscores, e.g. ["snowflake", "google_analytics"].

per_page.description: Results per page, max 25. Use page for more.

q_organization_name.description: Matched against company names and descriptions.

entity.description: Required. Exactly "person" (find people) or "company" (find companies). Each provider block then takes that entity's filters.

firecrawl_search.description: Firecrawl web search with the firecrawl_search query parameters, without page fetching: web results such as team pages, profiles and news. 2 credits per 10 results (10 with enterprise zdr), which is what max_credits counts. A team that scans results for threats also pays 2 per result, which max_credits does not count.

categories.description: Limit results to specific source types. `research` restricts ordinary web results to research-affiliated websites and returns page snippets, which is separate from the `firecrawl_research_*` tools that search paper abstracts and full text across biomedical (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv) and arXiv literature; `pdf` searches PDF results; `developer` searches an index built for coding agents over public repositories, GitHub issues, merged pull requests, repository READMEs, and code documentation; `gov` searches the Government Index of US federal, state, and local legal and regulatory sources, the index behind firecrawl_gov_search, and cannot be combined with other categories; gov hits can include historical versions, bill text, agency guidance, and third-party reproductions, so verify the issuer, jurisdiction, enacted/effective status, and version before citing current governing law, clarify a missing jurisdiction or ambiguous as-of date, and use general search for non-US questions or missing coverage (no hits does not establish that no applicable law exists). `developer` and `gov` return hits in `data.web` with `category` set to their name; the other categories also filter `data.web`.

domainTools.description: Include domain-matched tools for result URLs. Defaults to true when Alexandria is combined with web, news or images; semantic-only search leaves domain matching off.

excludeDomains.description: Hostnames to leave out of results. Mutually exclusive with includeDomains.

highlights.description: Return query-relevant page excerpts for web and news results when available (default). Highlights appear in web `description` and news `snippet`; otherwise, original snippets are returned. Set to false to keep the original search snippets.

includeDomains.description: Hostnames to restrict results to. Mutually exclusive with excludeDomains.

query.description: Query for web and semantic tool discovery. Operators include quoted phrases, `-term`, `site:host`, `inurl:term`, `intitle:term`, and `related:host`; the set is non-exhaustive. Browse the whole library with alexandria_library_search.

sources.description: Search sources; authenticated sessions default to web + alexandria, keyless sessions to web only. Authenticated searches always add alexandria to the sources, so sources: ["web"] also returns providers; domainTools: false turns off website-matched tools only. enterprise zdr or anon searches do not add it. Use ["alexandria"] alone for provider discovery without web results.

toolDetail.description: Compact by default. Compact returns only provider, capability and description; full includes contracts. Read a selected tool's contract with alexandria_library_search.

anyOf.description: entity person: FullEnrich people/search. 5 credits per record. List filters take [{"value": "...", "exclude"?: true, "exact_match"?: true}]; range filters take [{"min"?: n, "max"?: n}].

current_company_industries.description: LinkedIn's current industry names, e.g. Software Development or Computer and Network Security, not Computer Software.

current_position_seniority_level.description: One of Owner, Founder, C-Level, Partner, VP, Head, Director, Manager or Senior.

limit.description: Records to return, max 25, 5 credits each. Use offset for more.

anyOf.description: entity company: FullEnrich companies/search. 5 credits per record. List filters take [{"value": "...", "exclude"?: true, "exact_match"?: true}]; range filters take [{"min"?: n, "max"?: n}].

industries.description: LinkedIn's current industry names, e.g. Software Development or Computer and Network Security, not Computer Software.

limit.description: Records to return, max 25, 5 credits each. Use offset for more.

max_credits.description: Most credits this call may spend. Set it only to a budget the user gave; left out, it is 1000. The estimate checked against it is each provider's listed price times its unit (record, input, Apollo company page, or 10 web results), as if every record were found; a call whose estimate is higher is refused before any provider runs.

anyOf.description: entity person: People Data Labs person/search. 50 credits per record. Pass sql or query.

limit.description: Records to return, max 10, 50 credits each.

query.description: Elasticsearch query over the person schema, instead of sql.

sql.description: SELECT * FROM person WHERE ... Values are lowercase and match exactly, e.g. job_title = 'head of data'.

anyOf.description: entity company: People Data Labs company/search. 50 credits per record. Pass sql or query.

limit.description: Records to return, max 10, 50 credits each.

query.description: Elasticsearch query over the company schema, instead of sql.

sql.description: SELECT * FROM company WHERE ... Values are lowercase, e.g. industry = 'computer software'.
